reason: S1 adds eight public rotate helper entry points whose independently controlled x and n inputs are not exercised by H0. The existing bmp_fuzzer.c, cbor_fuzzer.c, gif_fuzzer.c, json_fuzzer.c, and png_fuzzer.c invoke decoder APIs and never call these helpers; merely including wuffs-unsupported-snapshot.c does not reach static inline functions. This is new API/input attack surface absent from S0, so the gap is commit-induced.
evidence: The S0-to-S1 diff newly defines wuffs_base__u8__rotate_left/right, wuffs_base__u16__rotate_left/right, wuffs_base__u32__rotate_left/right, and wuffs_base__u64__rotate_left/right.
Each new function accepts independently variable x and n and normalizes n with n &= 7, 15, 31, or 63 before performing shifts.

H0 calls wuffs_bmp__decoder, wuffs_cbor__decoder, wuffs_gif__decoder, wuffs_json__decoder, and wuffs_png__decoder entry points, but contains no call to any wuffs_base__u*_rotate_left or wuffs_base__u*_rotate_right identifier.
The new functions are static inline, so inclusion through release/c/wuffs-unsupported-snapshot.c alone does not execute them.
recommended_action: Add a focused base-API fuzz target that calls all eight rotate helpers with fuzz-controlled x and n, emphasizing normalized zero, width multiples, and values around each width boundary, and checks rotate identities or reference results.
